title: Send marketing emails and texts only with consent
what: Send commercial emails, texts and other electronic messages only with the recipient's consent (and with sender details and an unsubscribe facility).

sources.title: Spam Act 2003
sources.quote: A person must not send, or cause to be sent, a commercial electronic message that: (a) has an Australian link; and (b) is not a designated commercial electronic message.

triggers.note: Sending commercial electronic messages with an Australian link.

reach.condition: if it sends commercial emails, texts or other electronic messages

assessment.summary: Consent, identification and unsubscribe rules for commercial emails and texts, which legitimate senders largely meet anyway: no material effect.
